capabilities: Show outgoing links and backlinks for the active note in grouped grid columns
Search any note and switch the page to its links, like the quick switcher
Follow the active note as you move between notes
Open notes in place, in a new tab, or via context-menu options
Customize link styles (Hairline, Sky link, Soft tile), columns, sort, folders and aliases
extras: Not yet in the community plugin directory; manual installation from GitHub releases is required. Mobile support has been checked only in emulation. The plugin states it makes no edits, network requests, or tracking.
problem: Obsidian's backlinks and outgoing links are small side panes, so there is no calm, full-page way to see and browse both link directions at once.
summary: Full-page grid that lists every note linked to and from the active note, with quick-switcher-style search and customizable link styles.
